items.title: How quickly can you schedule a cleanout?
items.content: We offer same-day and next-day service for most jobs. For eviction cleanouts, we understand urgency is key — call us and we'll work to accommodate your timeline.

items.title: How much does eviction junk removal cost?
items.content: Pricing depends on the volume of items, property size, and services needed. We provide free, no-obligation on-site estimates. There are no hidden fees — the price we quote is the price you pay.

items.title: Do you offer deep cleaning with junk removal?
items.content: Yes! We're one of the few companies that offers both junk removal AND professional deep cleaning as a combined service. This means one team, one schedule, one invoice — saving you time and money.

items.title: What happens to the items you remove?
items.content: We're committed to responsible disposal. Usable items are donated to local charities and shelters. Recyclable materials go to appropriate facilities. We minimize landfill waste wherever possible.

items.title: Are you licensed and insured?
items.content: Absolutely. T&C Integrity & Reliable is fully licensed, bonded, and insured with general liability and workers' compensation coverage for your complete protection.

items.title: Do you work with property management companies?
items.content: Yes — property managers are one of our primary clients. We offer volume discounts, priority scheduling, and dedicated account support for property management companies with multiple units.

items.title: What areas do you serve?
items.content: We serve the greater metro area and surrounding communities. Contact us to confirm service availability in your specific location. We're always expanding our service area.
